name: Grounded narrative
description: Explain supplied material for a specified audience.

name: Case study and feature journey
description: Tell the story of a project: constraints, decisions, outcomes and transferable lessons.

name: Release notes and migration explanation
description: Explain a supplied release, changelog or migration to its users.

name: Technical explanation
description: Explain architecture, mechanisms, usage and limitations to technical readers.

name: Public-facing feature communication
description: Draft an accessible feature article, announcement, newsletter or social copy.

name: Community spotlight and digest
description: Credit a community member’s work or summarize supplied community updates.

name: Executive brief
description: Prepare a concise decision brief with evidence, trade-offs and unknowns.

name: Audience adaptation
description: Retell supplied existing content for a new audience or supported output format.

name: Story selection and editorial planning
description: Compare story angles from supplied material and recommend an audience-focused sequence.

name: Metrics and evaluation explanation
description: Explain supplied measurements, comparisons and evaluation results with their limitations.
